title: حد يعرف كيف يحولوا تطبيق من انجليش الى عربي
Recommendations/Requirements
body:
1. When will The year of you be added as most other calendars have it as basic feature and have had it since they existed?
2. We, as students, need to have a dedicated button for adding our time tables on schedules.
3. We cannot add an ending date to the already existed starting times, i.e: every day, every week, etc. Even when we go to ‘custom’, we cannot choose every week with an ending date of our choice.
author: Abady_
